request.text: Bigger spends go to the group. The three-hundred-dollar boat trip needs two of three… so Leo approves, right from a notification.
request.previous_text: Small spends approve themselves. Eighty-four dollars for groceries? Pot checks the rules… approved, and paid back in seconds.
request.next_text: When the trip's over, close the Pot. Everyone gets their fair share back.
